name: Kala-Goañv
text: Kala-Goañv is the Breton word for the opening of winter in the Celtic year. The term carries the sense of a calling or convocation. In Breton speech it marks the festival Samain. That festival stood upon the first day of November. Kala-Goañv therefore names the winter start of the year.

attributes.attribute: Breton term for the festival Samain

key_results: Give the Breton name of the festival.
Set the festival at the start of November.
